caption: Figure 3. Three-way accuracy of independent direct responses on all 1,760 cases from 55 source groups. Verdict-only accuracy checks supported, contradicted or insufficient-evidence labels. The stricter score also requires a licensed single-record evidence/operation proof for decisive answers; a correct scientific-insufficiency answer must use an empty selection and operation none. Malformed, missing, failed and truncated responses count as errors under the frozen parser. Checker rejections are not shown as three-way answers and receive no insufficiency credit. The deterministic public-payload oracle solves the explicitly stated task family, scoring 100% on both measures; it is a strong control, not a learned method.
